entities.summary: Fernando Francesco d'Ávalos d'Aquino, 5th Marquess of Pescara, , was Neapolitan military leader and nobleman of Aragonese origin. He was an important captain in the service of Spain and the Holy Roman Empire during the Italian Wars.
